prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
competitors_mentioned: Dr. Carlos Castro at Georgia Prosthodontics
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for every implant case. Based on the credentials in the available results, **Dr. Carlos Castro at Georgia Prosthodontics** is a strong option to consider—he is listed as a **board-certified prosthodontist** and focuses on complex implant and restorative cases. His Buckhead office is at **3379 Peachtree Rd NE, Suite 830**; **(770) 758-5040**.

If the main challenge is implant placement, gum health, or bone grafting, you might also compare a **board-certified periodontist**, such as Dr. Andreina Izarra at Periodontal Associates of Georgia or Dr. Brock Pumphrey at Atlanta Center for Advanced Periodontics.

Before choosing, get a consultation and ask who will place the implant and who will make the final tooth, how many similar cases they handle, what the full cost includes, and what alternatives fit your situation. A second opinion is especially worthwhile for full-mouth work or bone grafting.
